title: AgriSell Rider Meeting
subtitle: App Features to Discuss with Riders

pages.heading: 1. Rider pay
pages.lead: Discuss how riders should earn and receive their pay. Use their delivery experience to agree on clear app rules.
rows: Agree on a fair fee for each delivery. Consider distance, load, fuel costs and difficult roads.
Agree who will pay the rider and when the fee must be confirmed. Show the fee before the rider accepts an order.
Discuss extra pay for long waits, extra stops and return trips.
Agree when a delivery counts as finished and its fee appears in Earnings. Clearly show money still owed and money already paid.
Agree how riders return product payments to the farmer. Keep that money separate from the rider's delivery fee.
Agree how often riders receive payment and which payment method to use. Decide how riders report late, missing or incorrect pay.
paragraphs: Goal: clear delivery fees and payment steps that riders, farmers and the team understand.

pages.heading: 2. Deliveries and important app features
pages.lead: Discuss common delivery problems and the app features riders need most.
rows: Discuss how many kilograms and how much space each vehicle can carry. Riders must set a capacity within the app's vehicle limit.
Agree when a rider can accept another order. Consider total weight, available space, route and delivery time.
Agree who checks the weight, quantity and condition at pickup. Decide what to do when the goods do not match the order.
Discuss the pickup details riders need and how they will know the goods are ready. Decide what to do when the farmer is not ready.
Discuss clear addresses, map pins and landmarks. Agree how riders can contact the farmer or buyer when they need help.
Agree what riders should do if the buyer is absent, refuses the goods or the vehicle breaks down. Decide who handles returns and the rider's fee.
Discuss delivery photos, codes and signatures. Identify hidden buttons, missed alerts and features needed when the signal is weak.
Agree who riders should contact during an emergency. Choose the most important missing app features to work on first.
paragraphs: Goal: agree on the main delivery rules and the app improvements riders need first.
